A triangular plate with mass $M$ occupies the region $D$ enclosed between the parabolas $y=2-2{x}^{2}$ and $y=1-{x}^{2}.$
The mass density at each point is proportional to the square of its distance from the $y$-axis. Find the moment of inertia of the plate about the line $x=-1.$
